candidates.review: Retain checkpoint boost/restore source hooks and exports around native completion waits. Pin the task under stat_lock shared with successful publication and stop removal; restore on that snapshot before put_task_struct, avoiding NULL/stale-task access when remount stops the thread during the wait. Initialize saved priority. Preserve LTS synchronous fallback when no thread exists, request completion and stop-time draining; callbacks must coordinate overlapping boosts. Extracted stop-during-wait lifetime controls reject an unreferenced task.

Retain the restricted down-read callback, exported wrapper and native fallback. A callback setting skip must already hold the real rwsem. Pass NULL for read_waiters in fair-lock configurations, where that member does not exist; SDK unfair locking retains its queue. Extracted checks compile/run both configurations and reject duplicate acquisition. No lock is bypassed by default.

Retain the file-open source callback and declaration/export after native fscrypt, large-folio write and fsverity checks; quota open and finish_preallocate_blocks/error accounting still run afterward. This permits OEM per-inode policy without bypassing open checks. Pointers are borrowed for the call; a module must acquire references for retained state.

Retain the filesystem diagnostic callback, header and export with follow-up 45c752 NULL-sbi guard. Native printing/rate selection and va_end remain; the stack va_format/va_list is only valid during the synchronous callback. No new userspace diagnostic exposure is implemented.

Retain generic creation and bio-flag callbacks, declarations/exports and f2fs_write_begin tracepoint export. Adapt the obsolete fio->page conversion to native fio->folio. The UFS/SLC commit motivation does not restrict these generic APIs to UFS; no physical driver is added. Native create/link failure handling, block/crypto checks and bio lifetime remain; callbacks must preserve operation and integrity semantics.

Retain the explicit sbi test before the printk callback, preventing a NULL dereference in early diagnostics; native null-sbi printing and va_end remain. This fixes the earlier callback addition rather than omitting the interface.

Retain readahead op-flag callback, declaration and export. Native defaults are REQ_RAHEAD when rac exists and zero otherwise; the callback must handle NULL rac and preserve the read/crypto/integrity operation contract. Native block bounds and error cleanup remain outside this scoped flag customization.

Retain all seven buffered I/O, writeback, GC, ioctl, dnode and compression hooks plus exports and OEM inode storage. Native GFP_F2FS_ZERO clears the full allocation, making ACK explicit OEM memset redundant. Adapt result defaults to -EIO; preserve NOWAIT, outer permission/write/sync/preallocation handling, plug/accounting/mutex cleanup and skipped-write accounting even on callback success. Native GC atomic-inode references/validity checks remain on the normal path; bypass callbacks own correct operation/accounting/progress. Custom ioctls must implement command-specific authority/user-copy rules; compression veto unlocks i_sem. SECURITY.md records callback trust boundaries and extracted host regression coverage.

Retain submit and completion iostat callbacks/declarations/exports. Completion skip suppresses latency statistics only: native bi_private restoration and mempool freeing remain unconditional. The adapted direct-I/O wrapper restores iomap ownership and propagates status. Extracted iostat checks cover enable toggling, read/write, callback skip and I/O errors (64 cases/912 assertions), rejecting lost restoration and disabled-allocation regressions.
